bottleneck.conclusion: Tail latency is on the /ready dependency fan-out path; P95/P99 were 1586.11 ms while the cumulative route histogram has samples above 1 second.
bottleneck.evidence: The API only exposes route-level request-duration metrics, so latency cannot be attributed to one dependency. The only non-ready probe was optional vLLM (ConnectError); no inference request or GPU endpoint was invoked.
bottleneck.scope_limit: This is a light 8 GB local baseline, not a production-capacity claim.
